title: Show today's price in the order list
description: The order history page wants to show what each product costs today next to what the customer paid. GET /api/orders now also returns the product's current price. Includes tests and a README update.

comments.issue: Each order's `product` object (`{ id, name }`) is replaced by flat `productName` and `productPriceCents` fields, and the product id is dropped, so existing clients that read `order.product` break. The price could be added inside `product` instead.
